objective: Redesign and statically validate the Product Leadership Test 003 instrument so that every material defect recorded in PEND-LAB-048 is resolved by enforceable contracts, deterministic fixtures, schemas, traceability, validators, calibration cases, stop conditions, and chain-of-custody controls. Do not execute or simulate a retest and do not make any model request.
authorization_precondition: Do not begin modifications unless authorization 191 exists in GRANTED state with Jonathan Martínez as approved_by and the authorized scope is materially identical to this brief.

operating_directive.governance: ChatGPT defines scope and acceptance. Codex is the bounded technical executor and has no autonomous authority.
operating_directive.continuity: Once authorization and preflight pass, continue through implementation, deterministic validation, corrections, publication, and remote verification without repeated confirmation.
operating_directive.minor_issue_resolution: Resolve minor schema, formatting, naming, reference, index, fixture, validator, and documentation defects directly when the correction is clearly necessary to satisfy this brief and does not expand scope.

canonical_reconstruction_order: Resolve the live remote HEAD of main.
Follow its complete order of reading.
Read applicable decisions, authorizations, integrations, errors, pending records, evidence, reassessments, reconciliations, test designs, executions, roadmap, and current continuity.
Read project-sources/chatgpt/01_SOURCE_MANIFEST.md and sources 02 through 08 in the declared order.
Verify authorization 190 is consumed with no residual authority.
Verify PEND-LAB-048 remains open and authorization 191 is GRANTED.

included: Exact scoring-rubric calibration using fixed static cases
Runner provenance and future runner freezing
Fresh future retest gates and claim limits
Indexes, evidence, registry delta, pending state, and continuity synchronization
excluded: Any execution of a test arm
Any replay, retest, regeneration, or rescoring
Any mutation of Execution 004 or ATTEMPT-003 historical artifacts
Any modification of the Product Leadership candidate package
Any runtime, product, SSE, AWS, Terraform, Symphonie, selector, pointer, or integration-factory change

implementation_sequence.name: PREFLIGHT_AND_IMMUTABILITY_BASELINE
actions: Verify live main HEAD.
Verify authorization 191 is GRANTED.
Create the working branch from the exact authorized parent or perform a safe rebase if permitted by the authorization.
Inventory every governed Execution 004 and ATTEMPT-003 file.
Record SHA-256 hashes before modification.
Verify the working tree is clean and no historical file is scheduled for modification.

implementation_sequence.name: DEFECT_TO_REQUIREMENT_TRACEABILITY
actions: Decompose every PEND-LAB-048 defect into atomic requirements.
Map each requirement to its audit evidence, affected historical component, successor contract, validator, fixture, acceptance gate, and stop condition.
Reject undocumented fixes or inferred scope expansion.

implementation_sequence.name: FOUR_ARM_SYMMETRY
actions: Define a common canonical arm envelope.
Represent treatment differences as explicit typed deltas.
Equalize all non-treatment context, formatting, evidence, constraints, metadata exposure, and expected response contract.
Add a validator that normalizes all four arms and fails when any undeclared difference remains.
implementation_sequence.output: ARM_SYMMETRY_CONTRACT.json plus passing and intentionally failing fixtures.

implementation_sequence.name: SCORER_CONTEXT_ISOLATION
actions: Define the minimum scorer input contract.
Exclude arm names, treatment identity, package state, target conclusion, file paths, provenance hints, expected answer, prior scores, aggregate state, and hidden labels.
Define deterministic redaction and leakage detection.
Create fixtures proving each forbidden field is rejected.

implementation_sequence.name: NEGATIVE_CONTROL_REDESIGN
actions: Remove dependence on a model voluntarily following an instruction to produce a bad or refusing output.
Define fixed deterministic negative artifacts or structural controls with guaranteed negative characteristics.
Separate negative controls from ordinary experimental arms.
Document exactly which failure mode each negative control detects.

implementation_sequence.name: FIXTURE_ORACLE_ALIGNMENT
actions: Map every retained or successor fixture to the Product Leadership input contract.
For each fixture, declare tested capability, permitted assumptions, expected evidence, oracle logic, scoring dimensions, invalidating conditions, and claim boundary.
Remove or replace successor-design fixtures that cannot support a discriminating claim.
Do not modify historical fixtures in Execution 004.

implementation_sequence.name: INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE_AND_STOP_CONDITIONS
actions: Define INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE as an explicit result type.
Specify triggers for missing output, non-comparable arms, scorer leakage, broken custody, invalid fixture, inconsistent oracle, partial run, contradictory evidence, and failed calibration.
Ensure aggregation cannot coerce INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE into PASS or FAIL.
Define stop gates before requests, scoring, aggregation, adjudication, and publication.

implementation_sequence.name: EXACT_SCORING_RUBRIC_CALIBRATION
actions: Use the actual main scoring dimensions and aggregation formula, not a simplified surrogate.

Create fixed synthetic calibration cases for unequivocal pass, unequivocal fail, borderline, missing, malformed, refusal, contradictory, scorer-leakage, invalid-control, and insufficient-evidence scenarios.
Define expected dimension scores, aggregate result, confidence boundary, and stop outcome for each case.
Resolve any ambiguity that prevents deterministic expected results.

implementation_sequence.name: CHAIN_OF_CUSTODY_AND_FUTURE_RETEST_CONTRACT
actions: Identify the canonical future runner source.
Define exactly which files, prompts, schemas, fixtures, oracles, scorer instructions, dependency locks, environment declarations, and configurations must be frozen.
Require SHA-256 generation before future execution.
Require verification before each request and before adjudication.
Define artifact naming, append-only rules, timestamps, request IDs, output IDs, and score linkage.
Define future retest gates without granting authority to execute them.

implementation_sequence.name: DETERMINISTIC_VALIDATORS
actions: Implement validators for schema compliance, arm symmetry, scorer leakage, negative-control structure, fixture traceability, INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE propagation, stop-condition completeness, calibration expectations, custody completeness, duplicate JSON keys, references, indexes, and historical hash preservation.
Include positive and negative test cases.
Ensure validators genuinely exercise their declared contracts.
implementation_sequence.output: Runnable local validators and machine-readable results.

implementation_sequence.name: CANONICAL_RECONCILIATION
actions: Create evidence for the redesign.
Update PEND-LAB-048 only to reflect whether the instrument redesign is complete or remains blocked.
Do not close any future retest decision unless the canonical pending contract permits a redesign-only closure state.
Update applicable indexes, registry delta, current state views, repository-state expectations, and continuity.
Preserve no-retest and no-integration boundaries everywhere.

implementation_sequence.name: VALIDATE_PUBLISH_VERIFY
actions: Run the full deterministic validation suite.
Correct minor in-scope failures and rerun from the relevant earliest gate.
Confirm zero historical hash changes and zero model activity.
Commit intentionally.
Push the working branch.
Open a pull request with exact scope and prohibitions.
Squash merge only when all gates pass.
Verify remote main HEAD and exact published files.
Mark authorization 191 consumed only after verified publication.
implementation_sequence.output: Verified remote publication or a material BLOCKED report.

validation_requirements: Every referenced path and ID resolves.
Every PEND-LAB-048 requirement maps to at least one enforceable contract and validator.
All four arms normalize identically outside declared treatment deltas.
Negative controls are fixed or structurally non-refusable.
Every successor fixture has complete contract and oracle traceability.
INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE cases cannot become PASS or FAIL.
All stop-condition fixtures stop at the correct stage.
The exact scoring rubric passes all expected static calibration cases.
The future custody manifest is complete and deterministic.
All historical governed hashes match the preflight baseline.
No model call, test request, output generation, replay, or rescoring occurred.
Indexes, registry counts, canonical aggregates, expected repository state, and continuity are coherent.
The maximum declared result does not exceed redesign completion awaiting separate retest authorization.
acceptance_checks: All JSON parses successfully and contains no duplicate keys.
All applicable schemas and dedicated redesign validators pass.
Every PEND-LAB-048 defect maps to an enforceable contract and static fixture.
Historical Execution 004 and ATTEMPT-003 bytes remain unchanged.
Zero model request, retest, replay, regeneration or rescoring occurs.
The maximum result remains redesign completion awaiting separate fresh-retest authorization.

stop_conditions.condition: Authorization 191 is absent, proposed, consumed, revoked, expired, or materially different from this brief.
Remote main differs and a safe scope-preserving rebase cannot be completed.
stop_conditions.response: Stop and report the exact remote HEAD and conflicting paths.

stop_conditions.condition: Satisfying the redesign would require changing historical Execution 004 or ATTEMPT-003 artifacts.
stop_conditions.response: Stop; create no workaround that obscures the historical record.

stop_conditions.condition: A model request, replay, regeneration, or rescoring appears necessary.
stop_conditions.response: Stop; model activity is outside authority.

stop_conditions.condition: Any of the eight PEND-LAB-048 defect domains cannot be resolved or deterministically validated.
stop_conditions.response: Publish nothing as PASS; produce a precise blocked report.

stop_conditions.condition: The work requires package modification, integration, activation, runtime, product, SSE, AWS, Terraform, Symphonie, selector, pointer, or external repository changes.
Any acceptance gate remains failing after reasonable in-scope correction.
stop_conditions.response: Do not merge; report failing commands, artifacts, root cause, and exact remaining requirement.

pull_request_body_requirements: Expected parent and actual base HEAD
publication_contract.merge_condition: All acceptance gates PASS and no stop condition is active.
post_merge: Fetch and verify every required published artifact.

include: Remote main HEAD before and after publication
Confirmation of zero model requests and zero retest

include: Whether anything was committed or pushed
